snippet.title: New Years Resolutions Don't Work and What You Can Do Instead
snippet.description:
New Year is approaching meaning that a lot of us are thinking of resolutions for 2020, or in fact, for the whole decade ahead. I have bad news for you: New Year’s resolutions don’t work!

Numbers don't lie, according to research, 80% of New Year's resolutions don't make it to February and only 8-10% of the total number end up being realised. There's clearly a flaw in the system...

Let me tell you what strategy will work though so that you can start the next decade on a strong note! Spoiler alert: it involves setting goals that will achieve results and being strategic about forming habits. Watch the video to learn more

Join my 3-Day Reflection Challenge: https://codingblonde.com/3-day-reflection-challenge/

snippet.title: Feeling like an imposter? That's a good sign!
snippet.description:
Feeling like an imposter? Guess what, that’s a good thing! And let me tell you why!

Let’s start with what is imposter syndrome: it’s that feeling that you’re a fraud, that you’re not good enough, that you don’t deserve to be in the company that you’re working at or recognition for your work because you got there by luck. You can also feel inferior to people around you, that they’re way smarter and more talented than you. Comment “imposter” below this video if this is you!
